eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Eleven
subtitle: Lesson 102 · Database Design Fundamentals

code:
-- VIOLATES 1NF: not atomic, a repeating group
CREATE TABLE dbo.BadPersonDesign (
  PersonID INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  Name NVARCHAR(50),
  PhoneNumbers NVARCHAR(200)
  -- '555-1111, 555-2222, 555-3333'
);
caption: Unsearchable, unindexable — you can't ask "who has 555-2222" without parsing strings.

code:
SELECT p.FirstName, p.LastName, pp.PhoneNumber
FROM Person.Person AS p
JOIN Person.PersonPhone AS pp
  ON pp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
WHERE p.BusinessEntityID = 285;
caption: One Person, many PersonPhone rows — each with one atomic phone number, never crammed together.

code:
-- 1. Every column: one atomic value
-- 2. Every row: unique, has a primary key
-- 3. No repeating groups (Phone1, Phone2, Phone3...)
caption: This is exactly Lesson 100's one-to-many shape, used to fix a 1NF violation.
